title: 第9章四法第10章发喜财
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
不过喝了两口之后，他就立刻停下，依依不舍的舔了舔嘴唇，将最后一点酒味舔进去。
方才作罢。
酒喝多了，手抖。
适可而止。
高瘦师父选了一个最自在的坐姿，坐在一旁看许峰吃饭，许峰也明显的察觉到了他师父的欢喜。
故而东拉西扯了两句之后，许峰突然貌不经意的说道：“师父，你说啊，要是咱们上香的时候，看到香上的烟火比两掌还要高，都快要和大户人家的画壁一样大了，是不是也是凶兆啊！”
听闻此言，高瘦的赵二将酒葫芦收起来，看着许峰。
许峰以为自己试探的有些过了，想着怎么往回找补的时候，赵二嗤笑一声说道：“你小子！还没有学会走，就已经想要跑了？
这样的香谱你也敢想？你师父我啊，做梦都没梦见过这种情势呢！
你师爷传下来的的九道香谱之中，压根就没有这样的香谱状相！
这个架势的香谱，哪里是你我可以处置的了的？
你还是吃饭罢！以后别说这话，要晓得避谶！
你小子，脚踏实地，脚踏实地！学了基本的，再学这些上进的！你师父我为了学习这些，可是苦熬了十数年！”
许峰闻言，点头，闷头吃饭。
看样子，赵二没将许峰的话当一回事情。
但许峰也没继续问下去的打算了。因为他察觉到，这些问题再问下去，可能就触发了自己这个师父的疑心。
特别是现实之中“土地神龛”的事情。
许峰不知道外头的土地神如何。
但是他知道这社庙之中的土地神，有真灵在，故而他不可能在社庙之中，问关于土地神的事情。
尽管如此，就是这一点答案，在吃饭的时候，许峰的心就在不断的往下落。

‘这先民坟的事情，着实有些棘手。’
“望闻问切”，问怕是问不出什么了，那接下来的“望闻切”三道之中，是否还有手段，可以叫许峰搞清楚他在现实中的处境？
就如此，吃完了饭，休息了一会儿，就是清扫院落，烧水泼地的活计。
师父则是在善后。
昨晚的许峰，不过是缝合了一具尸体，其余的尸体，都是师父自己来的。
打扫完了院落，日头差不多已经挂在了房上，已经是上午了。
也不用歇息，许峰手里多出来了一份“图鉴”，是师父压箱底的东西，递给许峰，叫他学习。
许峰打开一看。
竟然类似于现代的“医学解剖录”，甚至多看两眼，还像是仵作的笔记总和。这些东西，叫许峰想到了一本古代的书籍。
宋慈的洗冤录。
“没你的事情了，你就在此学习罢！”
师父对着许峰说道，许峰连连点头，沉入其中。
整本书很薄，其中有许多地方，语焉不详，其内容更像是一本大纲，一个下午时间，足够许峰将这一本书翻烂了。
先读枝干，再填内容。
‘可以和外面的解剖学相互印证——不过远远不如解剖学来的完整，就是这其中有些方术，值得一看。’
在这薄薄一本书之中，有些利用了动植物的方术。
许峰默默地将这些记下来，算不得倒背如流，也是顺畅自若了。
除了读书。
许峰也没旁的事干，师父故意没有进来，就算是在外面做活，也故意压低声音，害怕吵闹到许峰。
content_en:
But after taking two sips, he immediately stopped and reluctantly licked his lips, licking in the last bit of the alcohol.
Just gave up.
I drank too much and my hands were shaking.
Enough is enough.
The tall and thin master chose the most comfortable sitting position and sat aside to watch Xu Feng eat. Xu Feng could also clearly sense his master's joy.
Therefore, after rambling a few words, Xu Feng suddenly said casually: "Master, tell me, if when we are lighting incense, we see the fireworks on the incense are higher than two palms, almost as big as the wall painting of a wealthy family, isn't it also a bad sign?"
After hearing this, the tall and thin Zhao Er put away the wine gourd and looked at Xu Feng.
Xu Feng thought that he had gone too far, and when he was thinking about how to go back and make amends, Zhao Er sneered and said: "You kid! You haven't learned to walk yet, and you already want to run away?
Do you dare to imagine such a fragrance spectrum? Your master and I have never dreamed of such a situation!
Among the nine incense recipes passed down by your master, there is no such appearance at all!
Where can you and I handle this fragrance spectrum?
You'd better eat! Don’t say this again in the future, and know how to avoid prophecies!
You boy, keep your feet on the ground, keep your feet on the ground! Learn the basics, then learn these more advanced ones! Your master and I have struggled for more than ten years to learn these things! "
When Xu Feng heard this, he nodded and ate silently.
It seemed that Zhao Er did not take Xu Feng's words seriously.
But Xu Feng had no intention of continuing to ask. Because he realized that if he continued to ask these questions, he might trigger the suspicion of his master.
Especially the matter of the "land shrine" in reality.
Xu Feng didn't know what the land gods were like outside.
But he knew that the earth god in the temple had a true spirit, so it was impossible for him to ask about the earth god in the temple.
Even so, with this answer, Xu Feng's heart kept falling while he was eating.
‘This matter of the ancestors’ graves is really a bit tricky. ’
"Looking, hearing and asking," I'm afraid I won't be able to get anything out of the question. So among the next three "looking, hearing, and asking," are there any means by which Xu Feng can figure out his situation in reality?
Just like that, after eating, we rested for a while and then started cleaning the courtyard and boiling water and splashing the floor.
Master is taking care of the aftermath.
Xu Feng only stitched up one body last night, and the rest of the bodies were all brought by the master himself.
After cleaning the courtyard, the sun has almost set above the house and it is already morning.
There was no need to rest, Xu Feng had an "illustrated book" in his hand. It was something that the master kept at the bottom of the box. He handed it to Xu Feng and told him to study.
Xu Feng opened it and took a look.
It is similar to a modern "Medical Anatomy Notes". Even after looking at it twice, it looks like the sum of his notes. These things reminded Xu Feng of an ancient book.
Song Ci's vindication record.
"It's none of your business, just study here!"
Master said to Xu Feng, Xu Feng nodded repeatedly and sank into it.
The whole book is very thin, and there are many places in it that are unclear. The content is more like an outline. Xu Feng can turn this book through in one afternoon.
Read the branches first, then fill in the content.
'It can be mutually corroborated with external anatomy - but it is far less complete than anatomy, but there are some tricks in it that are worth seeing. ’
In this thin book, some techniques of animals and plants are used.
Xu Feng silently wrote down these things, not just memorizing them fluently, but also smoothly and comfortably.
Except reading.
Xu Feng had nothing else to do. Master deliberately did not come in. Even if he was working outside, he deliberately lowered his voice for fear of disturbing Xu Feng.
